_instructions.overview: Cerebro Quant v5 configuration template. Copy this file to config_alpaca.json and replace every YOUR_*_HERE value with your actual credentials.
_instructions.telegram_section: Create a Telegram bot via @BotFather to get the token. Find your chat_id by messaging @userinfobot.
_instructions.alpaca_section: Sign up at alpaca.markets. Use paper-api.alpaca.markets for paper trading. Get API keys from the Alpaca dashboard.
_instructions.market_data_section: Register at twelvedata.com, finnhub.io for free API keys. All three price sources are optional — the system falls back gracefully.
_instructions.groq_section: Get a free API key at console.groq.com. The llama-3.3-70b-versatile model is free-tier eligible.
_instructions.trading_params_section: simbolos: list of ticker symbols to trade. min_confidence: minimum committee vote confidence (0-100) required to place an order.
_instructions.hf_token_note: If you want to export the forensic dataset to HuggingFace, set the HF_TOKEN environment variable (never put it in this config file).
